name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight shifted onto one leg, shoulders loose and ready, a confident, determined gaze toward the camera — a battle-ready stance, his expression bright and eager, hair whipping in the wind.
effects: A light wind catches his hair and cloak-edge.

components.wearing: fitted Windswept Jade-toned banded leather armor across the chest and shoulders, Cloud White stitching and buckles, arms left bare for freedom of movement, a reinforced belt and leg wraps; a feathered half-cloak at one shoulder, wind-sigils stitched along the collar
components.companion: his bonded Giant Eagle, a soaring raptor with wind-swept feathers, circling high above him

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the striker-group default wardrobe set + the existing cityscape-dusk background (windy skyline fit).
